/usr/bin/bash -lc "python3 -B -c 'import os,shutil,json,subprocess
names=[\"rg\",\"python\",\"python3\",\"bash\",\"find\",\"ls\"]
paths={n:shutil.which(n) for n in names}
rg=paths[\"rg\"]
print(json.dumps({\"PATH\":os.environ.get(\"PATH\"),\"which\":paths,\"rg_version\":subprocess.run([rg,\"--version\"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout if rg else None}))'"
